name: Toya Imamura
source:
While dancing is certainly the most visible aspect of Toya's theater act, it is but a small part of her overall skillset. Over the course of many Broadway performances, she has mastered line memorization, dialogue improv, and role shifting. Though most actors struggle with characters outside of their comfort zone, for Toya, adapting to a new act is as simple as a change of clothing and mannerism. 

Toya became partially deaf in both ears after a devastating stage accident. However, her disability has certainly not stopped her drive to continue dancing. Her enrollment in Bitokukawa serves as confirmation that, so long as her pursuit remains in the realm of possibility, Toya will never give up on herself or the goals she has in mind.

Toya's sense of humor also took a unique turn after the accident. Her newfound appreciation for dark comedy has amused and fascinated her friends and family.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1g6h2cl/meet_toya_the_former_ultimate_boradway_dancer/]bio[/url]]
